description:
Replace the hand-wave with the concrete lines and prove them.

=== DONE (s481a) ===

Quick start is now: apt (perl cpanminus make gcc curl ca-certificates bzip2
git), `sudo cpanm --notest PPI Moo`, the SBCL 2.6.0 binary from sbcl.org, clone,
`./pcl -E ...`, with the 2.5.2 substitution for Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12 named
in one line and the existing glibc table kept in Requirements.

RUN VERBATIM in a fresh ubuntu:24.04 container whose only additions were `sudo`
and an unprivileged user, so every other package in the transcript is installed
by the lines themselves.  TWO runs, because the batch is not pushed:

  RUN 1  the lines exactly as written, INCLUDING `git clone` of the public repo.
         Every line succeeds through the clone; the LAST line fails with
         "PCL: ASDF could not load cl-ppcre (Component :CL-PPCRE not found)"
         -- pushed main IS the install wall, measured.
  RUN 2  the same lines with the clone replaced by this HEAD: 2,4,6,8,10.

Transcript, harness and the line-source are in the agent worktree's
scratch/s481a/ (quickstart-ubuntu2404.log, quickstart-harness.sh,
quickstart-lines.sh).  WORTH RE-RUNNING once the batch is on main, when RUN 1
becomes the whole claim (~4 minutes).

Requirements: the cl-ppcre/Quicklisp bullet is replaced by "No Lisp libraries to
install" with the fallback said out loud; the SBCL bullet now names both install
shapes (sudo into /usr/local, which Quick start uses, and INSTALL_ROOT into
$HOME with no root) because the old text claimed only the second.

A new "Run it in a container" section follows Quick start (#1599's one-liner,
how to run a script, and one honest sentence that the image is not published
yet).  All README edits are ONE commit made after a rebase onto Fable's P2;
the first screen, Measured and Speed were not touched.
subject: P1(d): the README's install lines are commands that were RUN verbatim in a fresh ubuntu:24.04 container (transcript kept), replacing 'newer than most Linux distributions ship'
